facts.text: Maria started volunteering to help make a difference, inspired by her aunt who used to help her family when they were struggling.

evidence.quote: I started volunteering to help make a difference. My aunt believed in volunteering, and used to help my family out when we were struggling, so I'm inspired by her.

facts.text: Maria described a moment where she noticed an 8-year-old girl sitting alone and sad, which was the most impactful experience for her.

evidence.quote: For me, it was when I noticed a little girl around 8 sitting all alone. She seemed so sad. So, I sat with her and we talked.

facts.text: Maria was able to give the 8-year-old girl comfort and a listening ear, which led to them laughing and having a good time.

evidence.quote: I was able to give her some comfort and a listening ear. We ended up laughing and having a good time.
